why: The run died after 104 of its 240 minutes, before the harness computed its verdict and wrote pt-soak-02.json. It was a background task of the Claude Code process that launched it, and that process exited when the desktop app restarted at about 15:25; the harness, the API and both workers went with it. No fault in the stack was logged before it. The criteria below are recomputed from the recorded samples with the harness's own thresholds, as a record of the partial run only.
build: Release build of a git archive of 31a967c (W-0355, W-0356, W-0357 included; W-0358 not yet)
overlaps: The hosted pipeline for a push made at 14:14:46 ran its jobs on this machine from 14:15:32, inside this run's second quarter; the first quarter (the baseline) had ended at about 14:02.
